provenance.tools: tools/fit of Huginn 0.23.54 (branch r6-real-fit on engine-rewrite c826830; the yardsticks ran on this branch before its rebase from eaa0179; c826830 changed only the loader (row fields these logs do not have), and this file was exported after the rebase); export.py --spec "theta + b + recent + learn mult (D2)" --curve curve_encumbrance.json --hold-needs loadout_two_handed
provenance.chosen_by: roadmap R6 gate on the online train-on-past replay (tools/fit/honest.py, refit every 5 picks, warm start, 150 picks before the first tested launch, launch bootstrap 2000 draws): menu hit@8 minus A* lower end > 0 and all picks pooled hit@8 minus A* upper end >= 0
notes: Chosen: D2, the variant with the smallest part of the old score that passes the gate on the online replay (menu +40.2 [+35.3,+45.7], pooled -2.3 [-6.6,+1.6]). No variant without the old scorer passes: L1 (old learner state only) pooled -5.1 [-9.7,-1.0]; theta + b + recent -12.4 [-17.0,-8.1]; theta + b -16.2 [-20.0,-12.7].

D2 needs the old engine live in R8: FeatureBanditLearner (estimate, confidence, UCB), PriorCalculator (prior), UsageMemory (recency), lambda(confidence), and the old floors (fMinimumContextWeight, fMinimumUtility, cold start) that decide which rows are scored. It drops the context weights as a score term and the favourite, correlation and potion multipliers.
D5 (D2 + fav/corr/potion multipliers) pools +1.0 [+0.5,+1.8] better than D2 on the online replay (paired); not chosen because it keeps three more hand-tuned multipliers R8 retires.

This file differs from the evaluated D2 in two ways: theta is fitted on encumbrance read through the fitted curve (logistic 0.9887 73.42, curve.py) instead of the logged one (0.95 40), and loadout_two_handed is held at its prior (export.py --hold-needs): every log before 0.23.51 turned it on for the quarterstaff (85% of its contexts). Held, the fit's posterior on all 1865 picks rises by 23.7 nats (0.013 per pick).

The picks are the rehearsal's: the logs since 2026-10-28 17:30 hold no picks (launches of 0.23.47 with nothing records only), so the real fit is on the same 1865 picks as the rehearsal and the component test.
